question: Should review-required Policy doctor repairs be exposed through the generic `changes` channel even though no config is applied?
rationale: That output contract affects operator expectations and possible automation parsing, and `tools.alsoAllow` previews describe security-sensitive tool permission changes.

options.title: Preview once with clear skipped semantics
options.body: Keep the preview feature, but render each proposed config action once and make the skipped/non-applied state unambiguous in CLI and structured output.

options.title: Warnings only for review-required repairs
options.body: Do not put review-required previews in `changes`; keep them as warnings/effects so `changes` remains applied-repair-only.

options.title: Wait for the base stack
options.body: Leave this draft stacked until the gateway and tool preview base PRs land, then re-review the narrower `tools.alsoAllow` diff.

recommendation.title: Preview once with clear skipped semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the preview feature, but render each proposed config action once and make the skipped/non-applied state unambiguous in CLI and structured output.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior Policy posture/repair work and this stack's preview design.
